prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 2-1: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F2C, accent #861D24, secondary surface #EDEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Use body 14px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
